reason: We do library storytime, the park and church group for free, so paying $13 a visit is a hard sell. I'd probably take the free first visit to see it, but I wouldn't pay after that unless it really wins me over.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? And $13 a visit adds up fast when the library and parks cost nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A visit price around $8 or less, or proof that the Baby Nook is truly separated from the older kids and that the caps keep it calm.
